description: Test suite for decoding fixed-size HTTP/2 structures using Http2StructureDecoder, including various structure types like Http2FrameHeader, Http2PriorityFields, Http2RstStreamFields, etc., with tests for decoding literals, randomized data, and edge cases.

classes.description: Template class for testing decoding of HTTP/2 structures, providing methods for decoding, validation, and randomized testing.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Starts decoding a structure from a buffer, handling partial data and buffering.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Resumes decoding a structure from a buffer after partial decoding.

methods.name: DecodeLeadingStructure
methods.description: Decodes a structure from given data and validates it against an expected value.

methods.name: EncodeThenDecode
methods.description: Encodes a structure and then decodes it to verify correctness.

methods.description: Repeatedly generates random structures, encodes, and decodes them to test correctness.
